title: Developer-only prototype with two failed Critical controls
pins: A constrained environment lowers contextual risk without touching the failed status: both Critical controls stay failed and the checklist verdict stays BLOCK.
The same two failures are critical for the public scope the owner also targets, so that scope is blocked and appears under blocked_transitions on the developer-only readiness.
The scoped state (no_known_blocker for developer_only + prototype_demo) and the legacy verdict (BLOCK) differ, and the difference is explained on the readiness object rather than hidden.

application.name: Recipe Sorter
application.description: A weekend Lovable prototype that sorts recipes; runs on the builder's laptop against seeded fixtures.

data_summary: Seeded fixture recipes only. No accounts, no personal data, no payments.

findings.rationale: Every table is readable with the anon key: no row-level security policy exists in the migrations, and the reviewer reproduced an anon read against the local stack.

evidence.scope: Current working tree only, ruleset rls.missing. A regex heuristic has both false positives and false negatives; it is material for a human decision, never a confirmed finding.

findings.rationale: The search endpoint concatenates the query string straight into SQL.

evidence.scope: Current working tree only, ruleset sql.concat. Matches api/search.js line 22.

baseline.rationale: Reviewed in the walkthrough of 16 August 2026 with the builder present; nothing contradicting was found in the working tree.
baseline.screening_rationale: Screening question answered during the walkthrough: the prototype does not fall into the EU AI Act category this row screens for.

evidence.scope: One reviewer walkthrough of the working tree and the Supabase project settings on 16 August 2026. Covers what could be seen in that session and nothing beyond it.
